$description: Production integration boundaries. No providers, credentials, or endpoints are invented; each entry states current static behavior versus what production requires.

integrations.name: Contact form delivery
integrations.currentStaticBehavior: client-side validation only, simulated success after timeout, no network call
integrations.requiredProductionBehavior: POST to a server action or API route that forwards to email/CRM
integrations.dataInvolved: name, email, company, message, enquiry type
integrations.consentRequired: explicit consent checkbox before submission (already in UI)
integrations.security: server-side validation, rate limiting, spam protection (see Spam protection entry)

integrations.name: Strategy Call booking and calendar
integrations.currentStaticBehavior: hardcoded mock availability (next 4 weekdays x 4 fixed time slots), simulated submission
integrations.requiredProductionBehavior: real calendar-provider availability query and booking write
integrations.dataInvolved: full booking form fields, selected slot, timezone
integrations.consentRequired: explicit consent checkbox before submission (already in UI)
integrations.failureStates: already implemented: inline validation, submission error, retry
integrations.security: server-side slot re-validation to prevent double-booking, rate limiting

integrations.name: Email notifications
integrations.requiredProductionBehavior: transactional email on contact submission and booking confirmation
integrations.consentRequired: covered by the same consent as the originating form
integrations.failureStates: must not block user-facing success state on email-send failure; log server-side instead
integrations.security: no sensitive data in email subject lines, provider-side DKIM/SPF

integrations.name: CRM
integrations.requiredProductionBehavior: push qualified contact/booking records to CRM
integrations.consentRequired: yes, per privacy policy processing purposes
integrations.failureStates: CRM push failure must not block user-facing success; queue/retry server-side
integrations.security: server-side only, never expose CRM keys to client

integrations.name: Analytics
integrations.requiredProductionBehavior: page-view and conversion tracking, gated by Cookie Preferences 'Analytics' category
integrations.dataInvolved: anonymized/aggregated usage data per provider terms
integrations.consentRequired: yes, must not load before consent
integrations.failureStates: script load failure must not affect page functionality
integrations.security: no PII passed to analytics events without explicit review

integrations.name: Cookie consent / optional-script blocking
integrations.currentStaticBehavior: Cookie Preferences page persists choices to localStorage in the static prototype only
integrations.requiredProductionBehavior: real consent-management platform gating all non-essential scripts (analytics, marketing) until consent is recorded
integrations.dataInvolved: consent category booleans, consent timestamp, consent version
envVars: CMP_PROVIDER_KEY if a third-party CMP is adopted
integrations.failureStates: if consent state cannot be read, default to no optional scripts loaded

integrations.name: Spam protection
integrations.requiredProductionBehavior: bot mitigation on contact and booking forms (e.g., honeypot field minimum, CAPTCHA if needed)

integrations.name: Error monitoring
integrations.requiredProductionBehavior: production error tracking for form/booking failures and unhandled exceptions
integrations.dataInvolved: stack traces, request metadata, no PII in error payloads by default

integrations.name: Hosting and domain
integrations.requiredProductionBehavior: Next.js deployment target and DNS for axieonex.com

integrations.name: Content management for Insights articles
integrations.currentStaticBehavior: hardcoded article metadata and template, no full bodies
integrations.requiredProductionBehavior: either hardcoded MDX/JSON content files or a headless CMS, owner's choice
envVars: CMS_API_KEY if a headless CMS is adopted
integrations.status: pending owner decision, article bodies not yet written
